mapper.meaning: Name of the open mapper, without /dev/mapper/. Exactly one mount must match it.

op.meaning: Operation fixed by this stop, not a request field.

mountpoint.meaning: The uniquely resolved mapper mountpoint when one was found.

unlock.meaning: Observed policy, or null on refusal. A missing policy file reads as manual_passphrase.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Policy read refusal, or none once a policy is read.
